title_original: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙
full_text: Article 2 (Person Entitled to Apply) The Administrator of the National Veterans Affairs Agency may apply for permission to create a family relations register for a person of distinguished service to independence.
